# cloudxino_reserved_ip (Data Source)

A reserved IP of the team, by `ip_address` or `id`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cloudxino_reserved_ip" "web" {
  ip_address = "203.0.113.10"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `ip_address` (String) The address, e.g. `203.0.113.10`.

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) The ID of this resource.
- `project_id` (String)
- `region` (String)
- `server_id` (String) The CC2 server it points at; null when unassigned.
- `status` (String) `available`, `assigned` or `deleting`.
